item.create_biotech.surgery_guide.toolti: A player's guide to the _Surgical Table_ and the _Bionic Creatures_ it makes.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.title: Surgical Table and Bionic Creature Player Guide
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.1: This feature is unfinished, and future releases will change it in ways that are not compatible with older versions, so playing with it in a long-term survival world is not recommended. It is a fairly large system whose Ponder scenes are not finished yet; this guide covers how it actually plays.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.2: You can use the Surgical Table to take Slime Mimic Creatures apart and reassemble them. Parts can be rearranged and mixed with parts from other creatures; once joints are fitted, the head, arms and legs can move. Pack the finished body into a box and release it to get the bionic creature "Slime?".
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.3: How the result performs depends on which parts you keep, how you assemble them, and where the joints go. Some donors have properties of their own (unfinished).
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.4: This system may conflict with client-side mods that modify entity models on their own.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.quick_start: 1. Grow a Mimic Creature with a Petri Dish; see the Petri Dish's Ponder scene for details.
2. Capture the Mimic Creature in a Cardboard Box.
3. Lay out Surgical Tables. Tables that are horizontally adjacent and at the same height join into a single work surface, and a complex body needs a large one.
4. Place the box holding the Mimic Creature on the surface to turn it into parts. This cannot be undone.
5. Cut, arrange and glue the parts you need, then fit the joints.
6. Pack the whole body with an empty Cardboard Box, hold Alt to inspect its stats, and sneak-right-click to release the result.
7. A finished "Slime?" can also go back on the Surgical Table for further work.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.1: While holding the Surgical Kit, hold the kit key (Alt by default), move the cursor onto the tool you want, and release the key to switch to it.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.2: Tools inside the kit only work on a Surgical Table; the matching standalone tools and materials can be used directly as well.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.3: Aim at a part, seam, joint or tabletop and the screen shows which actions are currently available and which keys they need.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.4: Powering any Surgical Table of a connected work surface with redstone temporarily shows each part's original creature appearance, which helps identify where it came from; it does not change the assembled result.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.note: For a tool's exact keys, selection order and current step, follow the on-screen prompt while your crosshair is on a target. The table below only describes what each tool is for.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.shear: Cut a creature's original seams or the glue joins you added later; also dissolves or detaches a fused combination as a whole.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.shove: Discard the whole connected part you are aiming at and recover some slime balls; can also clear every part intersecting one tabletop.
Bond the selected positions of two parts together. Smart Super Glue also lets you nudge the position and tilt before confirming.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.honey: Fuse the entire connected part you are aiming at into one rigid combination, which is handy for building a torso, an arm or a leg segment first. Cutting and joint calculations treat that combination as a single part.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.slime: Add a glue seam between two cubes that already touch but are not yet directly connected.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.symme: Mirror an existing part across the centre face you pick, following the glue relations already there, and glue it in place; it does not conjure up new parts.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.wrenc: Remove the joint you are aiming at and recover the joint item.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.tempo: Hold one whole connected part aside, to reposition it or move it to another Surgical Table.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.empty: Pack the whole connected part you are aiming at as a finished creature. Anything left unattached stays on the table.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.cost: Cutting, gluing and honey-fusing normally cost no materials and no kit durability; a server owner can change that rule. Fitting a joint consumes the joint item, which you get back when you remove it.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.intr: Joints can be fitted to make parts move. Joints decide which parts count as a head, an arm or a leg, and give them the matching abilities and animation.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.neck: Turns the head to follow where the body looks; one body can fit at most one.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.shou: Marks the moving part as an arm so it joins in on attacks; at most eight.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.elbo: Bends the forearm along with the upper arm; it can attach to exactly one shoulder joint.
Marks the moving part as a leg so it joins the gait; at most eight.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.knee: Bends the lower leg through each stride; it can attach to exactly one hip joint.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.rule: A first-level joint (neck, shoulder, hip) cannot be chained below another first-level joint, and one moving part cannot be driven by more than one joint. A joint only fits between two parts that are directly connected but not honey-fused into the same combination.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.anim: Joints adjust their animation to the shape you actually built.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats: How the Finished Stats Are Decided
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.1: Maximum health follows the final model's non-overlapping volume, with diminishing gains as the body grows. Movement and attacks follow the final shape and working joints; donor stats are not inherited.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.2: This part is still unfinished; suggestions are welcome in the comments on the mod and the videos.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.inspe: With the bionic creature packed into a box, hold Alt to expand its details. It lists maximum health, damage (DPS), movement speed, armour, knockback-related values, working limbs, and donor-tissue traits. The DPS shown is a baseline that ignores weapons, enchantments, status effects and where exactly a target is hit.

Movement speed is affected by whether the legs reach the ground, how long they are, whether they have knees, and how much of the whole body they make up. Likewise, arm length, arm count and elbow joints affect attack reach, speed and swing area.

create_biotech.ponder.creeper_blast_cham: Creeper Blast Chamber Assembly
The structure supports 3 different sizes.
The center of the top face must be a Mechanical Press.
The center of the bottom face must be a Bio Packager.
The frame of the structure is built from Explosion-Proof Casing.
The center block of any side face, except the top and bottom, can be replaced with Blast-Proof Glass.
In addition, every structure must include a Blast Chamber Core.
It also needs two Explosion-Proof Item Vaults of any size; connected vaults count as one.
After the structure forms, the top edges are automatically replaced with Encased Chain Drives.
You can use a Wrench to swap between casings and chain drives, but enough chain drives must remain to power every press.
Creeper Blast Chamber Overload
The Creeper Blast Chamber can handle speeds up to 128 RPM.
Any speed above 128 RPM will send it into an overloaded state.
Do not overload it for too long, unless you want an explosion big enough to destroy your base!
Creeper Blast Chamber High-Pressure Implosion
Feed a high-pressure creeper into the chamber...
to switch recipes into High-Pressure Implosion mode.
High-Pressure Implosion mode has its own recipes and no longer runs Crushing Wheel recipes.
Of course, overload explosions also become much more powerful.
Creeper Blast Chamber Operation
The Blast Chamber Core can input and output creepers using cardboard boxes.
The largest blast chamber can have up to 9 creepers working at once.
Apply rotational force...
For each creeper inside, the chamber takes one batch of items from the input vault, runs the matching Crushing Wheel recipe, and outputs the result to the output vault.
Hold right-click on a vault to switch it between input and output.
Creeper Blast Chamber Introduction
This is a Creeper Blast Chamber.
It can process Crushing Wheel recipes efficiently in bulk.
Or... are you looking for something more explosive?

Before placing a Shulker Packager, right-click another Shulker Packager (or regular Packager) to select an output target.
After receiving a request, the Shulker Packager teleports the package to its selected target.
Shulker Packagers are suited for short-range transport; for long-range transport, use Cargo Allay Stations, Package Frogports, Trains, Postboxes, and similar options.
Check their Ponder screens to learn how they behave.
create_biotech.ponder.shulker_teleporter: Shulker Teleport Stations can teleport players, creatures, or dropped items between two stations.
Set this station's address and its target address in the interface.
Once sealed, entities inside are teleported to the target station.
create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_s_e7373: Mimic and bionic creatures drop no items when killed, but split into living Slimes
Trading with mimic villagers only yields Slimeballs as well
Apply Regeneration to a mimic creature...
Then use an Encased Fan and Soul Campfire to haunt it
This transforms the mimic creature into a normal mob
create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_scene_1: Slime Petri Dishes can be used to cultivate mimic creatures
Insert a Living Mechanism into the Petri Dish...
Then pipe in Liquid Living Slime...
The Liquid Living Slime mimics a nearby mob and grows
Mobs with more maximum health require more Liquid Living Slime to mimic
create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_s_21db7: Allay Couriers can target players for delivery.
Use "@player" in the address field to target a player.
create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_scene_1: Cargo Allay Stations can be used to deliver packages remotely.
Set this station's address in its interface.
Cargo Allay Stations automatically pull packages from the Packager or container below and dispatch an Allay Courier to the specified Cargo Allay Station.
The interface lets you configure whether the Allay Courier returns after delivery.
Allay Couriers have no delivery range limit and can even travel between dimensions.
However, make sure all stations involved are in loaded chunks.
create_biotech.ponder.tag.ponderer_expor: This mod's Ponder scenes were created and exported with The Ponderer. Learn more: https://modrinth.com/mod/the-ponderer
create_biotech.jei.trait.donors.title: Donors (%s)
create_biotech.jei.trait.donors.scroll: Scroll or use the arrows to change pages. Donors are identified using the current server's trait rules.
create_biotech.jei.trait.donors.incomple: Could not inspect %s creature types; this list may be incomplete.
create_biotech.jei.trait.open: View recipes or uses to read about this trait
create_biotech.jei.trait.defaults: This page describes default rules. Check the surgical table and creature tooltips for actual effects.
create_biotech.jei.trait.carrier.all: Any retained tissue from a donor with this trait
create_biotech.jei.trait.carrier.fallbac: Prefer %s; use %s only if the donor has no definition for the preferred tissue. Removing it does not trigger this fallback
create_biotech.jei.trait.carrier.head: Head
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.presence: Presence: retaining matching tissue in the required region grants the full trait, with no minimum coverage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.threshold: Threshold: matching tissue must occupy at least %s%% of the region and meet any additional conditions.
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.scaled: Scaled: any positive tissue coverage contributes. Strength scales with its volume fraction c (0 to 1).
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.numeric: Scaled: take the highest-value %s%% of the region's volume and calculate its weighted average. Missing contributing volume counts as zero.
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.effects: Threshold: each effect is evaluated separately. Its immune tissue must occupy at least %s%% of the whole body.
create_biotech.jei.trait.coverage.region: Coverage includes all retained tissue in the applicable region, including ordinary tissue. Removed cubes do not count. The torso excludes heads, arms and legs.
create_biotech.jei.trait.coverage.limb: Coverage is calculated separately for each head, arm or leg joint chain. Ordinary tissue in that chain counts; other limbs do not dilute it.
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.breat: Additional condition: No Breathing must not be active.
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.wings: Additional conditions: at least two arms must meet the threshold, regardless of wing side. Body volume must be recorded and cannot exceed 16 times the effective wing tissue volume.
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.legs: Additional condition: at least %s effective legs attached through hip joints must each meet the threshold. Knees do not count as extra legs.
create_biotech.jei.trait.fire_immune.des: Prevents fire damage and ignition. Once acquired, the separate Fire Resistance entry is hidden in creature tooltips.
create_biotech.jei.trait.fire_resistance: Multiplies fire damage by (1 - c). Even a small amount of resistant tissue provides partial protection. Hidden in creature tooltips while Fire Immunity is active.
create_biotech.jei.trait.water_sensitive: Contact with water or rain causes damage. This is a negative trait inherited from donor tissue.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_immune.d: Prevents freezing and freezing damage. Once acquired, the separate Freezing Resistance entry is hidden in creature tooltips.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_resistan: Multiplies freezing damage by (1 - c). Hidden in creature tooltips while Freezing Immunity is active.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_vulnerab: Multiplies freezing damage by (1 + 4c). This negative trait combines multiplicatively with Freezing Resistance.
create_biotech.jei.trait.sun_sensitive.d: Ignites for 8 seconds under suitable sunlight conditions. A helmet blocks the sunlight and may lose durability instead.
create_biotech.jei.trait.moisture_depend: Starts a 120-second moisture timer outside water, rain or bubbles. Once dry, takes 1 damage per second. Water, rain or bubbles reset the timer.
Continuously attempts to deal 1 fire damage in hot biomes where Snow Golems melt, subject to the normal damage cooldown.
create_biotech.jei.trait.inverted_healin: Reverses Instant Health and Instant Damage: healing causes damage, while harming restores health.
create_biotech.jei.trait.fall_damage_imm: Prevents fall damage. Once active, Agile Landing is no longer shown separately in creature tooltips.
create_biotech.jei.trait.no_breathing.de: Removes the need to breathe, prevents drowning and suppresses Dry Suffocation. Does not grant Swimming Specialist.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wingless_flight: Grants gravity-free flight, flying movement and navigation, and fall immunity. Contributing tissue must be retained in the torso.
create_biotech.jei.trait.body_bounce.des: Adds 0.1 times c to upward velocity when jumping.
create_biotech.jei.trait.projectile_defl: Reflects incoming projectiles, except wind charges fired by players or Breezes.
create_biotech.jei.trait.contact_retalia: After a living attacker directly deals damage, retaliates with 2 times c thorns damage. Does not retaliate against thorns or damage that bypasses Guardian thorns.
create_biotech.jei.trait.water_breathing: Prevents drowning underwater. Only requires matching tissue in the head, with no coverage threshold. Does not grant Swimming Specialist.
create_biotech.jei.trait.dry_suffocation: After 15 seconds outside water or bubbles, takes 1 drying damage per second. Water or bubbles reset the timer. No Breathing suppresses this negative trait.
create_biotech.jei.trait.tameable.descri: An unowned creature can be tamed with a Slime Ball. Its owner can toggle sitting with an empty-hand interaction; it follows and helps its owner fight. Losing this trait clears ownership. Slimes split off on death inherit the owner.
create_biotech.jei.trait.vibration_sense: Listens for vibrations from an existing target within 12 blocks. When the target is out of sight, follows its latest sound position for up to 2 seconds. Respects sneaking and wool occlusion; does not select new enemies.
Adds 16 to water pathfinding cost, encouraging the creature to avoid water. This preference alone does not cause water damage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.deterrence.desc: Every half-second, repels matching creatures within 8 blocks and clears their aggression toward the assembled creature. Targets depend on the donor: Cats repel Creepers and Phantoms; Wolves repel Skeletons. Excludes creatures with the same owner, tamed Wolves and Killer Bunnies.
create_biotech.jei.trait.agile_landing.d: Prevents fall damage when enough effective legs are present. Hidden in creature tooltips if whole-body Fall Immunity is already active.
Subtracts 3 blocks from fall distance, then multiplies the fall damage multiplier by 0.5.
create_biotech.jei.trait.powder_snow_wal: Allows walking on top of powder snow. Foot tissue must be installed as legs, with enough effective legs present.
create_biotech.jei.trait.lava_walk.descr: Allows standing on lava. Does not grant fire immunity; the body still needs separate protection from fire damage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wall_climb.desc: Allows climbing during horizontal collisions. Each leg is evaluated separately, and enough effective spider legs must be present.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wing_flight.des: Grants gravity-free flight, flying movement and navigation, and fall immunity. Wings must be installed as arms, with enough effective wings and sufficient lift.
create_biotech.jei.trait.swim_specialist: Multiplies movement input in water by 1.35. While not flying, uses smooth swimming control, amphibious navigation and aquatic wandering. Requires only torso coverage, with no arm or leg count requirement.
create_biotech.jei.trait.effect_attack.d: Hits by the arm containing the matching tissue inflict Poison I for 5 seconds, Wither I for 10 seconds, or Hunger I for 7 seconds. Hunger requires an unarmed hit. Mouthparts or spines installed in the head or torso cannot provide this melee effect.
create_biotech.jei.trait.active_spines.d: Taking damage or detecting a non-allied living creature within 1 block activates spines for 5 seconds. While active, stings nearby non-allies once per second for 1 thorns damage and 3 seconds of Poison. Spines may be retained anywhere on the body.
create_biotech.jei.trait.shell_defense.d: Taking damage triggers 4 seconds of shell defense: stops navigation, adopts a crouched pose and multiplies movement input by 0.25. Damage that does not bypass armor is halved.
Rejects each status effect whose immune tissue meets its coverage threshold. Multiple immunities can coexist: half Poison-immune tissue and half Wither-immune tissue grant both immunities.
create_biotech.jei.trait.natural_armor.d: Sets the creature's base armor to the inherited weighted value. For example, using Zombie tissue with armor 2 for half of the body grants 2 natural armor.
create_biotech.jei.trait.knockback_resis: Final knockback resistance is 0.15 plus the inherited value, capped at 1. Only torso tissue contributes.
create_biotech.jei.trait.passive_regener: While below maximum health, restores the inherited amount of health once per second. Calculated using whole-body tissue.
